native_review.summary: The conversation successfully completed the user's request: authentication was performed via name and zip code after email lookup failed, the agent correctly denied splitting payment across two cards, informed the user the most expensive item was the Action Camera at $481.50 (satisfying the natural language assertions), and could not cancel a single item. The agent then switched all eligible items to their cheapest available options, reducing the total to $1130.85, obtained explicit user confirmation, and executed the modification. The only issue found was a minor policy violation where the agent made five tool calls simultaneously instead of one at a time; this did not affect the outcome.

errors.reasoning: The agent issued five get_product_details tool calls in a single turn without waiting for each response. The policy explicitly states that the agent should make at most one tool call at a time. Although the parallel calls succeeded and did not affect the final outcome, this violates the explicit policy constraint on tool call sequencing.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made one get_product_details call at a time, waiting for each tool response before issuing the next call.

auth_classification.reasoning: The initial authentication attempt via email failed (user not found), but the agent then successfully authenticated the user using name and zip code, retrieving the account and proceeding with order modifications.
